FAQ常见问题

怎么开始一天？

在「今日」页先写好当天草稿，排好任务顺序，然后按「准备开始」。

按了「准备开始」还能改吗？

不能。启动后当天任务流就冻结了，这是设计本身，用来让你在启动前认真想一遍。

没做完的任务去哪了？

到了当天截止时间仍未完成的任务，不保留详情，只在「过去」板块留一个数量记录。这是有意为之，不是数据丢失。

iCloud 同步怎么开？

设置 → iCloud 同步。默认关闭。数据存在你自己 Apple 账户的私有数据库里，开发者读不到。

换手机数据还在吗？

开了 iCloud 同步就在；没开的话数据只在本机，卸载 App 会一起删除。

订阅怎么取消？

iOS 设置 → Apple ID → 订阅 → Weekyii。App 内不能取消，这是 Apple 的规则。

买了 VIP 但没生效？

先在 VIP 页点「恢复购买」；还不行就发邮件，附上购买时间和 Apple 订单号。

想反馈问题或提需求？

发邮件到上面那个邮箱，尽量附上机型、iOS 版本、Weekyii 版本，以及复现步骤。

FAQFrequently asked questions

How do I start a day?

On the Today page, write your draft first, put the tasks in order, then tap the start button.

Can I change things after I start?

No. Once a day is started, that day's task flow is locked. That is by design: it asks you to think it through before you commit.

Where do unfinished tasks go?

Tasks not completed by the day's cutoff are not kept in detail. Only a count is recorded in the Past section. This is intentional, not data loss.

How do I turn on iCloud sync?

Settings → iCloud Sync. It is off by default. Your data is stored in the private database of your own Apple Account, which the developer cannot read.

Will my data still be there if I change phones?

Yes, if iCloud sync is on. If it is off, data lives only on this device and is deleted when you uninstall the app.

How do I cancel a subscription?

iOS Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions → Weekyii. You cannot cancel inside the app; that is Apple's rule.

I bought VIP but it is not active.

First tap "Restore Purchases" on the VIP page. If that does not work, email us with the purchase time and your Apple order number.

How can I report a problem or request a feature?

Email the address above. Please include your device model, iOS version, Weekyii version, and the steps to reproduce the issue.
